newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes steady in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes steady in volatile trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed steady at 1.0390 per dollar on the commercial foreign exchange market after a volatile day of trading that swung between 1.0385 and 1.0415 per dollar, dealers said.
Players said they speculated over dollar inflows and outflows as they have done over the past few days.
"The market will continue looking at and trading over dollar flows until the end of the year," one trader said.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real dropped 0.02 percent to close at 1.0432 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended at 1.135 per greenback, 0.44 percent down, traders said.
